name: dimension-drifters
description: Dimension Drifters — online co-op bullet-heaven. See DIMENSION_DRIFTERS_MASTER_SPEC.md.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "pnpm --filter @dd/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/server dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/client dev"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server -c gray,blue "pnpm --filter @dd/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/server dev"
scripts.dev:client: pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && concurrently -n shared,client -c gray,green "pnpm --filter @dd/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/client dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,client,electron -c gray,blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @dd/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/server dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/client dev" "pnpm --filter @dd/desktop dev"
scripts.gen: node tools/artkit/gen-weapon-expansion.mjs && pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && node tools/artkit/gen-weapon-muzzles.mjs && pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && node tools/artkit/gen-dimensions.mjs && node tools/artkit/gen-dimension-subjects.mjs && node tools/artkit/gen-vfx-subjects.mjs && node tools/artkit/gen-character-roster.mjs && node tools/artkit/gen-card-manifest.mjs && node tools/artkit/gen-w4r-projectiles.mjs --manifest-only && pnpm weaponsmith:aggregate && node tools/artkit/build-weapon-vfx.mjs && node tools/portal/gen-portal.mjs
scripts.gen:check: node tools/artkit/gen-weapon-expansion.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && node tools/artkit/gen-weapon-muzzles.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-dimensions.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-dimension-subjects.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-vfx-subjects.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-character-roster.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-card-manifest.mjs --check && node tools/artkit/gen-w4r-projectiles.mjs --manifest-only --check && pnpm weaponsmith:aggregate:check && node tools/artkit/build-weapon-vfx.mjs --check && node tools/portal/gen-portal.mjs --check
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @dd/shared exec tsc --noCheck && pnpm --filter @dd/server exec tsc --noCheck && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter @dd/shared build && concurrently -n shared,tests -c gray,yellow "pnpm --filter @dd/shared dev" "vitest"
